notes.subject: המשלים
notes.rationale: Ol i tanim 'ol man i save tokim tok patun' (mashal), tasol sampe i tok 'ol man i gat nem long tok stori'.

notes.subject: חשבון
notes.rationale: Heshbon i min 'olsem tingting/wokim kalkulasen' — nem bilong ples i wokim pilai tok long stori bilong ves 27–30, Tok Pisin i no inap holim.

notes.subject: Kam insait long Heshbon
notes.rationale: Em i tok patun bilong ol Amori i singautim man long kam — ironi long dispela ol i lusim Heshbon.

translation: Olsem na ol man i save tokim ol tok patun ol i tok: Kam insait long Heshbon, bai ol i wokim i kamap olgeta na strongim taun bilong Sihon.
